title: Close surface-profile friction: review threads on native routes and profile drift
objective: Make the PR review-thread helper usable from every governed repository, including native publish routes, without widening its authority, and remove the drift between ops/autonomy/surface_profile.yaml and the rules and surfaces it governs (findings F1a, F1b, F1c, F2, F3, F4, F5).
success_criteria: S1: with no .l9/pr/pr-summary.json, pr_threads.py writes only when a live REST proof shows the PR is open, its head repo is origin, its head ref is the checkout branch, and its head SHA is an ancestor of or equal to local HEAD; every failed or unreadable fact refuses before any POST (proved by V1)
S2: the receipt path is unchanged: a present receipt still decides ownership exactly as before (proved by V1)

S3: settings.template.json and the committed .claude/settings.json allow `Bash(python3 ~/.cursor-governance/ops/scripts/pr_threads.py:*)`, still allow the relative form, and still allow no raw `gh api` POST (proved by V1 and V4)

S4: surface_profile.yaml forbids pull_request_review_approval, declares post_push.pr_watch, names native routes in post_push, carries the Infisical GITHUB_TOKEN pat_ref with bare gh removed, and has a current updated date; the preflight hook cites post_push.pr_watch (proved by V1 and V2)
S5: autonomy contracts, Claude settings projection and the Claude adapter validators pass on the changed tree (proved by V2, V3, V4 and V6)

todos.task: In ops/scripts/lib/pr_thread_routes.py keep load_summary and the receipt branch of require_own_pr unchanged. When the receipt file is absent, prove ownership live: GET repos/{origin}/pulls/{n} through the injectable run (`gh api --method GET`), require state open, head.repo.full_name equal to origin (case-insensitive), head.ref equal to the checkout branch from `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` (detached HEAD refuses), and `git merge-base --is-ancestor <head.sha> HEAD` exit 0. Any unreadable fact, non-JSON or failed command refuses through fail(). require_own_pr takes run as a keyword argument. A null head.repo (deleted fork) refuses. A head SHA absent from the local object store makes merge-base exit non-zero and refuses; nothing is fetched to make it pass. Update the module docstring to name the home-relative allowlisted form.
